note: Washington County, IA publishes parcels only through the Beacon (Schneider) viewer, a Cloudflare-protected proprietary app with no public ArcGIS REST service. The official county GIS page links only to Beacon. The Iowa GMA 2025 parcel-program layer marks Washington County (COUNTYFP 183) parcel access as 'Internal' (PRCLACCS=I), i.e. not publicly accessible. Regrid's nationwide MapServer is tile-only (query returns 404). Remaining parcel sources are paid third-party shapefiles.
